tei:div.tei:p: (101)༄༅// rgyal dbang dpal yul ba'i yab sras rnams la bsngags pa drang srong bden tshig zhes bya ba bzhugs so// maṅga lam// (102) nges gsang theg mchog rjogs pa chen po 'bum phrag drug cu'i rgyud kyi ston pa dga' rab rje// sde gsum klong dgu'i nges gsang smra la mi 'jigs seng ge'i sgra chen sgrogs mdzad shrī seng*// mkhyen rtogs dgongs pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs pas stong pa'i mkha' dbyings skyil krung gis bzhugs sa gsum pa// padma'i zab gter padmas 'byin mdzad thang rgyal dngos sprul kun bzang shes rab mchog der bsngags// 1) rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rjes rjes bzung bas// rgyal bstan snying po mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi// rgyal bstan spel phyir sras mchog sgra gcan 'dzin// rgyal de mi yi rdzu la zhugs min nam// 2) rmad byung za hor mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i// snga 'gyur sdom rgyun smad 'dul rin po che'i// brgyud de byams pa 'bum las pakṣis gsan// de byung chags maid zhabs las 'di yis gsan// 3) phyis su bka' brgyud bstan khrod bzhugs pa phal// rnying mar sdang dang gsar zhen che ba 'gas// kha che bsod snyoms chen po'i brgyud kyis bsgyur// deng sang kam tshang phyogs la 'di mi bzhugs// 4) 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang rgyal tshab mi pham pas/ (103)/rjes bzung klu thogs zhi ba lha yi srol// zab rgyas zung 'jug byang chub sems bskyed kyi// sdom rgyun gsan te rgyal sras chen por gyur// 5) snga 'gyur bstan 'dzin ratna badzra las// 'dus pa mdo dang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud// sems klong man ngag mdzod bdun ya bzhi sogs// gsan te snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing bzung*// 6) rgya mtsho'i mtshan can gsum dang khyad par du// rgyal mchog ston pa rgyal mtshan zhabs bsnyen te// rgyal ba klong chen rab 'byams las brgyud pa'i// rgyal dgongs mthar thug man ngag snying thig gsan//

7) khyab bdag 'di la so zur gnubs gsum las// kun mkhyen dharma klakṣa sogs brgyud de// mdo sgyu sems gsum dbus nas brgyud pa yang*// da lta'i bar du ma nub nyi ltar gsal// 8) gzhan yang chos rje dam gtsang byams gsum las// khams lugs brgyud pa nyid kyang bdag gir mdzad// dngos su ma mjal na yang dag snang sgor// gter bdag gling dang mjal bar gdon mi za// 9) rgyu mtshan de yis bka' ma'i chog khrigs dang*// rig 'dzin thugs thig la sogs gter chos rnams// nyid kyi phyag bris can la gter chen gyis// phyag thel phog pa dngos su yod pa dang*// 10)/gdangs dbyangs lag len sogs kyang smin lugs dngos// gdangs yig phyag dpe dngos su bzhugs pa dang*// 'gyur med rdo rje 'dra ba'i rnying ma la// bka' drin che ba su yang med ces gsungs// 11)gzhan yang padma'i zab gter 'byin pa la// gu ru padma dngos su byon 'dra ba'i// dpal gyi seṅge mi 'gyur rdo rje dang*// lang gro lo tsā klong gsal snying po'ang bsnyen// 12) thub pa'i bstan la thub pa'i mdzad pa can// thub dbang spyan ras gzigs dngos a ra ga (104)/thub bstan gsar rnying dbyar gyi skyed tshal las// thub bstan snying po snga 'gyur chos rnams blangs// 13) de sogs mtshan ldan bshes gnyen mang bsnyen nas// snga 'gyur bka' gter rgyun bzang mchis so 'tshal// ma lus lhag med hub kyis bzhes nas kyang*// grub pa chen po'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs// (14)de yi thugs sras lhun grub rgya mtsho yang*// brtan mkhas yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis sgegs// 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i dgongs don rtogs// mchog thun grub pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol son// 15) yab sras slob ma padma nor bu yang*// thos bsam bsgom dang mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms// snga 'gyur mkhan slob chos rgyal ring lugs kyi// bka' gter bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i khyu mchog gyur//

16) de yi thugs sras chos dpal bzang po yang*// nus mthus nag po'i sder bcas tshar bcad nas// dkar phyogs rgyal mtshan dgung du sbreng bzhin du// yum ka bde chen rgyal mos dngos grub ster// 17) de rjes don dam mtshan sgren rtogs pa'i gdeng// thob pas nges don bstan pa'i lam srol bzung*// dkon mchog zhabs kyis chos srid bstan spel kyang*// rgyun bzang 'ga' zhig 'od gsal dbyings su thim// 18) de rjes 'gyur med nges don snying po yis// rdza brgyud bla ma mtshams pa'i zhabs la bsnyen// klong snying gtsor byas snga 'gyur bstan pa'i dpal// bskyed pa 'jigs med rang grol chos 'byung gsal// 19) de yi thugs sras rgya sprul paṇḍi tas// kun bzang shes rab las brgyud mdo sgyu sems// la sogs rnying ma bka' ma'i sgrub mchod rgyun// btsuugs te rnying ma'i mtshan gzhir dngos su grub// 20)de yi thugs sras rje btsun bla ma yis// dpal dge 'jam mgon rnam gsum sogs bsnyen nas// snga 'gyur bka' ma'i spar gyi 'phrul chen gyis// (105)snga 'gyur bstan pa rgya mtsho'i srog shing mdzad// 21) de ltar snga 'gyur chos sde rgya mtsho'i phul// rgyal dbang dpal yul ba zhes mngon par mdzes// rdo grub kun bzang gzhan phan zhal nas kyang*// nyams len rgyun la dpal yul ba 'dra med/ 22) /kun mkhyen si tu dharmā ka ras kyang*////////////////////////////////

/rje nyid dpal yul dgon du phebs pa'i tshe// rtogs ldan de rnams shwa khyu 'drogs pa bzhin// bsu bar phebs byung ces ni yang yang bsngags// 23) o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po nyid// mdo smad kram khog gnas su byon pa'i tshe// chu ni war 'dzugs sgo ni 'dam sbyar can// dpal yul sgrub khang 'dra ba gang na'ang med// 24) 'jam mgon paṇa chen mi pham rgya mtshos kyang*// snga 'gyur bka' gter rgyun bzang 'phyugs med du// 'dzin pa dpal yul ba 'dra dka' zhes par// dam pa'i mkhas grub rnams kyis yang yang bsngags// 25) bsngags de gzur gnas rnams kyis drang po'i gsung*// drang srong bden tshig dngos yin phyogs zhen gyis// smra ba'i rgyu mtshan btsal kyang rnyed mi srid// de phyir bsngags 'os ton tan rgya mtsho'i gzhi// 26) 'di ni 'dod 'byung dbang gi rgyal po dang*// bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin legs (106)mthong nas// 'phrog tu med pa'i dad de rjes 'brang// de la bsngags brjod 'khyog min drang po 'dir/ (107) */ (108) */ (109) (110) (111)slar yang smras pa/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus rgyal dbang dpal yul ba// yab sras brgyud par bcas pa de rnams kyis// snga 'gyur bka' gter nor bu'i mdzod 'dzin pas// rdor smin zhe rdzogs kaḥdapal zhes su grags// de drug snga 'gyur rnying ma'i chu mgo ltar// gang las 'byung ba'i gzhi ni yin nges na// rnying ma rang rkang tshugs pa ma byung phyin// gsar min rnying min red tshe chu mgo snyogs// de phyir rgyal dbang dpal yul ba yi srol// mdo sgyu thabs lam phyag rgya chen po dang*// grol lam 'od gsal rdzogs chen snying thig gnyis// zung du 'brel ba phyag rdzogs zhes su grags// mkhan slob chos rgyal bi ma'i thugs kyi mdzod// gnyags gnubs zur pa rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i lung*// kun mkhyen yab sras thugs la brnags pa'i mdzod// nyang gur byang dang gling pa bcu gcig sogs// mchog gi rig 'dzin bgrang las 'das pa rnams// grub pa'i go sar gshegs pa'i bgrod gcig lam// lam 'di 'dzin la dpal yul ba zhes grags// grags pa'i rna lung phyogs kyi bu mos byin// rnying ma'i ma dgon chos sde drug po der// gter chos 'ga' yar dar srol che chung las// snga 'gyur rnying ma'i yab chos mthar thug pa// mdo sgyu sems gsum 'dzin la khyad par med// mdo sgyu sems gsum rang rkang ma tshugs na// gter chos tsam gyis rnying ma dngos ma yin// de ni gsar ma la yang yod pa'i phyir// mdo sgyu sems gsum grub mtha' ma nyams zungs// khyab bdag bla ma kun bzang shes rab kyis// mdo sgyu (112)sems gsum bka' ma'i gzhung bsrangs nas// gter rnying tshad ldan rnams kyis zur brgyan pa'i// phyag bzhes mchog 'di yid bzhin nor bu 'dra// phyag bzhes 'di nyid 'chug med bzung ba la// sngon byon kun mkhyen yab sras legs bshad dang*// phyis su 'jam mgon rnam gsum legs bshad la// brten nas 'khrul pa med pa 'ong snyam bgyid// bkra shis gang zhig nyan thos theg pa'i gang zag bdag med gser 'khor rtsibs stong 'bar ba bzhin// rkyen rtogs pa yi chos bdag phyed rtogs rten 'brel 'byung ldog phyogs las rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan bzhin// byang chub sems dpa'i bdag med yongs rdzogs gzhan phan lhur len gter gyi bum pa bzang po bzhin// bya ba'i rgyud kyi rje 'khol rnam pas rigs gsum sar bgrod ma chags padma rgyas pa bzhin// spyod pa'i rgyud kyi spun grogs rnam pas rigs bzhi'i sar 'gro chos dung g.yas su 'khyil ba bzhin// rnal 'byor rgyud kyi gnyis med rol pas rigs lnga'i zhing bgrod gser nya 'dab gshog rgyas pa bzhin// ma hā yo ga'i dag mnyam chen pos rig 'dzin mchog brnyes dpal gyi be'u bkra ba bzhin// a nu yo ga'i bde stong dbyer med zhu bde'i dpyid thig rin chen gdugs bzang mdzes pa bzhin// sems sde'i gser 'khor klong sde'i nor bus gtams// phyi skor btsun mo nang skor blon po dang*// gsang skor glang po yang gsang khregs chod rta// thod rgal dmag dpon rgyal srid rin chen bdun// bdag sogs yid can 'gro ba ma lus pa//

(113)lam mchog 'dir zhugs snang bzhi'i sa lam bgrod// kun bzang khyad chos drug gi rgyal thabs la// tshe 'dir 'khod pa'i bkra shis dpal 'bar shog / ces grub dbang rgyal ba dpal yul ba'i yab sras rnams la bsngags pa drang srong bden tshig 'di ni snga 'gyur bstan pa'i gral mthar skyes pa padma ma ṇi'am sgra dbyangs padma'i myu gu zhes bya bas smras pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// /
